entries.question: Is there a cancer patient    treatment
entries.answer:
I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.

Yes, KGMU provides comprehensive cancer treatment services. You can find information regarding the relevant departments here:

*   **Medical Oncology:** [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=59&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=59&dept_type=2)
*   **Surgical Oncology:** [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=33&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=33&dept_type=2)
*   **Radiotherapy:** [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=29&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=29&dept_type=2)

**How to book an appointment:**
*   **Online:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in)
*   **Phone:** 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333
*   **SMS:** Send "APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]" to 8887019134

Please remember that online registration is mandatory for OPD services. For urgent care, please proceed to the Trauma Centre (Gate 14).

entries.question: Kgmu b pharma ke form kab niklenge merit ke hisaab se
entries.answer:
KGMU mein B.Pharma aur anya courses ke admission aur form nikalne ki jankari ke liye, main aapko KGMU ki official website **[www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)** par "Admission" ya "Notice" section check karne ki salah dunga.

Vahan par exam schedule aur application form se sambandhit sabhi latest updates upload ki jati hain. Admission merit ke aadhar par honge ya entrance exam ke dwara, yeh University dwara jaari ki gayi official notification mein spasht roop se likha hota hai.

Aap samay-samay par website check karte rahein taaki aap koi bhi deadline miss na karein.
entries.ai_question_translated_en: When will KGMU B.Pharma forms be released on merit basis

entries.question: Kya merit se b pharma kgmu me kar sakte hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein B.Pharma admission ki prakriya ke liye, main aapko spasht kar doon ki KGMU aam taur par apne courses ke liye **entrance examination** (pravesh pariksha) conduct karta hai.

Seedhe merit (12th ke marks) ke aadhar par admission ke sambandh mein KGMU ki koi aisi common policy nahi hai. Admission ke niyam har saal University ke **Admission Brochure** mein jari kiye jate hain.

Sabse sahi aur official jankari ke liye aap ye steps follow karein:

1.  **Official Website:** [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par visit karein.
2.  **Admission Section:** Wahan "Admission" tab mein jaakar B.Pharma ka current brochure check karein.
3.  **Notice Board:** Kisi bhi naye notification ya merit-based admission ki ghoshna ke liye "Notice" section ko regular check karte rahein.

**Ek mahatvapurn baat:** KGMU mein admission sirf official website par di gayi guidelines ke anusar hi hote hain, isliye kisi bhi anya srot (source) par vishwas na karein. 

Kya aapne is saal ke liye koi specific notification dekha hai ya aap pichle saalon ke pattern ke baare mein puch rahe hain?

entries.question: How I can take admission in KGMU for msc nursing being a resident of west bengal
entries.answer:
To seek admission for the M.Sc. Nursing program at King George's Medical University (KGMU), please note the following:

1.  **Eligibility and Entrance:** Admission to M.Sc. Nursing courses at KGMU is typically conducted through a centralized entrance examination process (often the KGMU M.Sc. Nursing Entrance Examination). Candidates must hold a B.Sc. Nursing degree from a recognized institution.
2.  **Residency:** KGMU is a state university in Uttar Pradesh. While students from other states like West Bengal are generally eligible to apply, admission criteria regarding "domicile" or "unreserved" seats are strictly governed by the state government's reservation policy and the university's annual admission brochure.
3.  **Official Information:** You must check the official university website for the current year's admission brochure. This document will detail:
    *   Whether the exam is open to candidates from all states.
    *   Specific eligibility criteria, including registration with the Nursing Council.
    *   Important dates for the application form, entrance test, and counseling.

**Action Steps:**
*   **Check the Website:** Please visit [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) regularly under the "Admission" or "Academic" section for the most current notification regarding the M.Sc. Nursing entrance exam.
*   **Admissions Office:** For specific queries regarding non-UP resident eligibility, you can contact the Controller of Examinations office or the College of Nursing at KGMU directly through the contact details provided on the university website.

**Note:** Please do not share any personal details like your address, phone number, or academic records in this chat for your safety. Always rely on the official KGMU website for admission updates.
